## Bug Fixes
- **Power Five now means the Power Five.** The panel listed the five highest-DPS heroes; the term is a
  fixed set — Treebeast, Ivan, Brittany, The Masked Samurai, The Great Forest Seer — the five you
  return to after unlocking a new hero. The panel shows each one's level against the wiki's target
  (2075 / 2075 / 2075 / 2425 / 2775), gilds and current DPS share, plus one line naming who is
  actually carrying the run right now.
- Heroes tab `P1`-`P5` marks follow the same fixed set instead of a DPS ranking.
